verdict.rationale: Grok's API natively reasons over user data. The collections search tool retrieves from uploaded knowledge bases, attaching documents triggers an agentic attachment_search workflow, and tool calling explicitly covers querying your data. Together these let the model generate insights and suggestions from a user's own data. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented insights/suggestions experience rather than general-purpose reasoning over data, and independent hands-on corroboration of data-analysis quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: The collections search tool enables Grok to search through your uploaded knowledge bases (collections), allowing it to retrieve relevant information from your documents to provide more accurate and contextually relevant responses.
Grok can search through and reason over documents you attach to chat messages
enabling Grok to perform actions beyond generating text—like searching the web, executing code, querying your data, or calling your own custom functions.
